page.notes: The left column ends with a partly printed line at the foot, cut off by the scan edge. The right fragment at the top right ("tui, 49. Leovardia suae urbis defensionem arripit & militem regium portis prohibet. 60. 70. exercitium religionis reformatae") is the start of a column that continues on the other part of the page; its last line is cut off. The reading "[uo]" is doubtful; "Librandus" is doubtful (the initial may be a long I). A small mark stands to the left of some lines, not text. The lower-left lines (quejentiq..., Lemmariæ..., Leovardia...) sit to the left of the vertical rule; they are read after the right column as the last entries of this part. The first line at the top and the first entry ("quejentiq") are partly cut and only partly legible.
